messages:
Alex: quick favor — I'm seeing a small RSS regression on the quant canary (2.4 -> 2.6GB). Can someone run the mem microbench on the canary pool and collect jemalloc stats + heapshot? Steps below.

Priya: what's the bench name? I can kick it off.

Alex: ./scripts/bench/run_mem_bench.sh --suite=smallalloc-pattern --iterations=5 --canary=true --profile-dir=/tmp/perf

Sam: I'll run it on canary-us-east-1-4 at 11:30 PT. Will upload artifacts to s3://redwood-perf/eng-runtime/1718204567/

Marta: also grab `mallctl` stats and `jeprof` if possible. `MALLOC_CONF` we usually set: `lg_chunk:22,dirty_decay_ms:0,muzzy_decay_ms:0,background_thread:true`

Sam: got a run, attaching quick logs:
```
RSS before: 2.41GB
RSS peak: 2.74GB
madvise calls: 0
kvcache entries: 0
``` 

Rachel: interesting, madvise=0 suggests we didn't trim. Can you run with MALLOC_CONF='retain:true' off and enable background_thread=false to force declaims?

Alex: Trying small tweak: set `MALLOC_CONF=lg_chunk:22,dirty_decay_ms:10000,muzzy_decay_ms:10000` — might help fragmentation.

Marta: also try `MALLOC_CONF: retain:false,background_thread:true,dirty_decay_ms:1000` — we want faster decay.

Sam: re-ran with dirty_decay_ms=1000. RSS peak back to 2.45GB. Seems better.

Alex: ok that points to fragmentation + stale arenas. Can we get a heapshot + jemalloc epoch dump? run:
```
echo epoch | sudo tee /proc/$(pidof model_server)/oom_score_adj
# or via jemalloc API
echo 'stats.print' | je-mutate
```

Priya: I don't think the second command exists. Use `jeprof --raw <binary> <profile>` pattern. I'll coordinate with Sam to grab one.

Sam: uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/eng-runtime/1718204567/{bench.log,jemalloc.dump,heapshot.tar.gz}

Alex: thanks. Quick ask: whoever triages, add the benchmark config and the exact docker image tag used (image: sha256:abc123). We need to see if quant kernel selection changed memory layout.

Rachel: pinging eng-ml: @Dave any recent quant kernel changes? Could be different per-device memory alignment.

Dave: we merged a small allocator-pad change two days ago to improve simd alignment. I'll review if it touched arena sizes; shouldn't but could.

Marta: next steps: 1) triage jemalloc dump for retained extents, 2) rerun with forced madvise/decay settings, 3) check quant kernel image diff. Assigning Sam+Priya. I'll open a follow-up PR with suggested MALLOC_CONF defaults for canaries.

Sam: noted. Will add test case to bench harness to fail if RSS regresses >5% vs baseline.

Alex: awesome. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: 

ci-bot: build #4567 completed for sha256:abc123 — tests passed.
